old_copy.deleted_with: the launch-video removal pull request of the writing-gate lane, which names this folder as the new home

preserve: each result is checkpointed as it lands and the report is validated before it is written
raw probabilities, confidence, timing and every request and response are kept
a reply whose model or serving identity differs from health is an error, never a result
nothing unjudged becomes a pass: errors are kept as errors
summaries by criterion, family and source kind with confusion matrices and abstentions
allowed_deltas: endpoint, model, attempts and workers come from the person's settings row (tools/settings) or arguments instead of environment variables
the evaluation runs as a function the row calls with a stand-in post that plays recorded replies; the command line keeps the old flags
banned_substitutions: a default endpoint or model named in code
